by
  have hX_1 : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω = 1 → X ω = 1 := assume ω h, h
  have hX_0 : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω = 0 → X ω = 0 := assume ω h, h
  have hX_eq : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω = 0 ∨ X ω = 1 := hX
  have hX_disj : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω = 0 ∨ X ω = 1 := hX_eq
  have hX_meas : Measurable X := AEMeasurable.measurable hXmeas
  have hX_integrable : Integrable X μ := AEMeasurable.integrable hXmeas
  have hX_zero : ∫ (x : Ω), X x ∂μ = ∫ (x : Ω), (if X x = 0 then 0 else 1) ∂μ :=
    by rw [integral_eq_integral_of_ae_eq hX_integrable hX_eq]
  have hX_integral : ∫ (x : Ω), (if X x = 0 then 0 else 1) ∂μ = μ {ω | X ω = 1} :=
    by rw [integral_indicator hX_meas hX_disj]
  exact hX_zero.trans hX_integral
